elements.before: Independent, lender-grade analysis for retail real estate across conventional bank, CMBS, life-company, SBA, USDA, and bridge capital. This page is our standing read on why open-air retail is supply-starved while department-store-anchored malls stay distressed, how tenancy and lease-up forecasts fail review, and the difference between the market study, the feasibility study, and the appraisal a lender requires.
elements.after: In 2025 Coresight Research tracked 8,270 US store closures and 5,270 openings,8 yet open-air centers stay supply-starved while department-store-anchored malls remain distressed. That split is why tenancy, co-tenancy and lease-up decide retail credit. Send Feasibility Study Company the center or the pad: the firm prepares retail real estate feasibility studies for landlords, developers and the lenders on the deal, built on a trade-area market study, the rent roll and the anchor, for bank, CMBS, life-company, SBA, USDA and bridge review.
